summary: Frontend-only regression on Pre-Book overview redesign, Shipment detail redesign, My Orders line-items mode, Dashboard stat cards v3, plus Marketplace/Settings smoke. All requested testids present and behaving as specified. No horizontal overflow on mobile 390 for Pre-Book overview or Shipment detail. Drop 1 & 2 show 'Window closed' and Drop 3 CTA opens builder with prebook-back visible. Shipment IS-0012 hero, 7-stage rail with 'Released' and 'Stage 5 of 7', requirements section rendered, subtotal exactly $17.00, chat message adds chat-msg-0, docs-download-all fires toast '3 documents downloading…', si-edit opens si-form and si-cancel closes it, coo-toggle-detail hides Certificate of Origin doc, shipment-back returns to list (4 rows). My Orders line-items mode has 0 .od-thumb elements. Dashboard shows spend-delta, stat-aging, stat-terms-timeline, spend-range-toggle. Marketplace and Settings load without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: spend-range-toggle appears to render a single element rather than multiple range buttons — could not exercise a range change to verify spend-delta updates dynamically. Consider exposing individual range option testids (e.g., spend-range-<key>) so future automation can verify the value change deterministically.

Minor: after clicking Settings in sidebar, window.location.hash remained '#marketplace' although the Settings page rendered correctly. Hash routing may not update on that specific navigation — consider keeping hash in sync for shareable URLs and back-button behavior.
test_credentials: None — Log In with empty fields
context_for_next_testing_agent: All acceptance criteria from iteration_10 review passed. spend-range-toggle only exposes 1 clickable child in the current build so range switching couldn't be executed; if this feature is expanded, request explicit per-range testids. Navigation inside the SPA must go via sidebar buttons — page.goto with a hash does not switch pages. Shipment detail is opened by clicking the first tr[data-testid^=shipment-row-] on the Shipments list.
